verdict.rationale: Plaid's data access is split into separately documented products (Auth, Balance, Identity, Transactions), and the Sandbox endpoint lets a developer specify 'initial products' for an Item, which implies product-level requests rather than a single blanket grant. However, the pack never documents product-scoped consent screens or any explicit data-minimization controls. A community report that Link flows give no indication users are sharing more than bare account numbers lowers confidence but does not concretely refute product scoping. Missing for 10: first-party docs on how products map to user consent scopes, documented data-minimization or field-level controls, docs on adding or removing scopes after linking, and independent hands-on corroboration that requesting one product limits the data shared.

support.subject: As a developer, I request only the data scopes I need — product-scoped consents and documented data-minimization controls, not an all-or-nothing grant
